System Integration: Hydronic Loop Connections The hydronic loop was designed to connect the modified RTU and the two TES tanks (Figure 52). Pressure gauges measured the pressure drops across each component of the hydronic loop. Additionally, a flow meter was installed to measure the water pump flow rate. The two TES tanks were flushed out of any trapped air and connected to the modified RTU plate heat exchanger (Figure 53). The hydronic pipes were filled with tap water and were well insulated (Figure 54).
